headline: Rams' Alaric Jackson punched Bills' Bradley Chubb after game
summary: Jackson will be facing NFL discipline for approaching Chubb after the game and throwing a punch.

headline: Bills QB Josh Allen earns first overtime win of career vs. Rams on MNF
summary: Josh Allen came through with his usual late-game theatrics in leading the Bills to a 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on "Monday Night Football," breaking his careerlong winless streak in OT.

headline: Marvin Harrison Jr. Passes Texans Physical; Houston’s Week 5 Result Affected Trade?
summary: The Cardinals and Texans’ Marvin Harrison Jr. trade is now official. The third-year wide receiver passed his Texans physical Monday and will begin preparing to make his Houston debut. headline: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel To Miss Time
summary: The 49ers are 5-0, but injuries continue to plague the oft-malady-stricken team. San Francisco’s receiving corps, in particular, has absorbed a few blows. Deebo Samuel left the team’s Week 5 win in Seattle, and he will represent another missing piece moving forward. Samuel will miss time due to a hamstring injury, Kyle Shanahan said Monday […]

headline: Jim Harbaugh says he, Chargers ownership 'in this fight together' amid 0-5 start
summary: With the Chargers off to an 0-5 start for the first time since 2003, coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that he and the team's ownership group are "shoulder to shoulder where we're in this fight together."

headline: Mike Pettine Coming Out Of Retirement To Join Cowboys’ Staff
summary: Mike Pettine’s winter departure from the Vikings’ staff was classified as retirement. But the veteran staffer later said he was not sure if he would return to coaching.
